notes: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2025 (Nintendo's 85th fiscal year; data.js fy 'Mar 2025'). The main source is Nintendo's English 'Annual Report 2025', a translation of its Japanese Annual Securities Report under J-GAAP (the Japanese original prevails), plus the English AGM convocation notice. Both are on nintendo.co.jp.The relation enum has no value that fits; 'investor' is used only because it asserts no office he has not held. It should not be displayed as his role. OWNERSHIP: Miyamoto holds 4,000 shares (the Annual Report directors table shows 40 hundred shares as of June 26, 2025). No percentage is disclosed; it is far below 0.01% of the 1.16 billion shares outstanding, so pctEconomic is null. LARGEST HOLDERS: these are the three largest disclosed holders that are not trust-bank or custodian nominee accounts. They come from the large-volume holding reports that Nintendo quotes in notes to its major-shareholders table, each with its own report date. Nintendo says it 'could not confirm the actual number of shares held as of March 31, 2025', so all three are stale. Their shares likely sit inside the trust-bank lines of the register, which is why those lines are not listed. Other disclosed holders: the Nomura Securities group (5.00% as of March 15, 2024) and, on the register at March 31, 2025, The Bank of Kyoto (4.19%) and The Nomura Trust and Banking Co. (MUFG Bank, Ltd. Retiree Allowance Trust Account, 3.62%). The last is the same 421,090 hundred shares that MUFG Bank reports in its group's 6.23%, so it is not listed separately. DIVIDENDS: the cash-flow line 'Dividends paid' (¥193,191m); the J-GAAP statement shows no separate line for non-controlling interests. BUYBACKS: there was no share repurchase program; the only purchase of treasury shares was ¥2 million (fractional-share purchases), which rounds to 0.00 billion. STOCK COMP is null: Nintendo grants restricted stock only to Directors, it reports only their compensation amounts, and it has no stock option scheme ('Description of stock option scheme: Not applicable'). No company-wide share-based payment expense is disclosed. GEOGRAPHY: The Americas includes the U.S. (¥419,399m), which is not listed as a separate segment to avoid double counting.
